name: Globe Union Industrial Corp.
summary: Globe Union Industrial Corp. operates as a global producer and vendor of plumbing essentials, conducting business both within Taiwan and across international markets. The company's extensive product line encompasses a wide array of items, including water fixtures like faucets and showerheads, various sanitary ceramic wares, essential fittings and valves, alongside other related plumbing components, kitchen and bathroom solutions, and supplementary accessories. These offerings are marketed under several proprietary brand names such as Gerber, Prima, Lenz, RefleXion, and Bathroom To Love. Additionally, Globe Union Industrial Corp. serves as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) for other businesses. Founded in 1979, the enterprise maintains its primary headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.
